Ganga River Water Level Rises Above Warning Mark in Varanasi

The water level of the Ganga River in Varanasi has risen above the warning mark, with reports indicating it is increasing at a rate of 2 centimeters per hour. The Varuna river also poses a flood risk, potentially affecting approximately 30,000 houses. Authorities have issued warnings regarding the rising water levels.
